crossRefs.note: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came…
In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came…
So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
“Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.
Yahweh of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem, and besieged it.
translations.bsb: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his entire army and laid siege to the city.
translations.kjv: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged
translations.asv: And it came to pass when Jerusalem was taken, (in the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and besieged it;
